criteria.C1: L0, -10 % spring: closing assist >= 0 over the stroke at 3.5 / 5.5 / 7.0 MPa (targets 0.05 at MEOP, 0.08 at 5.5 MPa)
criteria.C2: L1 AND L2, +10 % spring: max opening torque over bench + start (<= 0.3 mm, 5.05/7.0 MPa, torch 1.5 bar) + hot-fire line <= 0.60 N m (HV69 stall 0.90 N m at 7.4 V / 1.5)
criteria.jam: needle held closed, HV69 stalled opening, -10 % spring, pin friction 0 (lower bound): static capacity s0 >= 1 (exceptional event; parts replaced after any recorded jam)

fit_note: v2.2 stack C (link eye 4 mm + 2 mm webs / bearing A 4 / nested one-sided dog 1 / spline 4; crank side bearing B, wall, spiral spring 6): y_l window 10.4-13.45 mm = 3 mm slack; an eye wider than ~7 mm closes the window (HV69 case corner at the case top vs the 8 deg cone at z ~254 on one side, crank housing on the other)

jam.basis: 7.6 V (covers the ~7.57 V upper tolerance), -10 % spring, pin friction 0: friction cannot be relied on to absorb the servo stall torque, so the v2.2/Electronics '~600 N' (plain-pin mu 0.15 credited) is NOT a design value
jam.direction: link, carriage, stem in TENSION (servo opening, needle held in the seat); one-sided dog -> the servo never pushes the needle closed: link compression <= +10 % spring hold 321 N

plain_3mm_DU.src: v2.2 pins: 17-4PH H900 pin in a PTFE-lined (DU-class) bush or dry-film; mu 0.15 = Combustion check basis (ASSUMED), lower bound 0 for the jam load
plain_3mm_DU.capacity_note: static bearing pressure 68 MPa at the jam: PTFE-lined steel-backed (DU class) static limit is a maker value (TO-VERIFY, commonly quoted ~250 MPa AS RECALLED); hardened pin H900

ball_623ZZ.src: NSK 623ZZ 3x10x4, Cr 695 N, C0r 218 N (RS Components datasheet https://docs.rs-online.com/9a61/A700000014623800.pdf)

needle_HK0408.src: NTN HK0408T2 Fw 4 x D 8 x C 8, Cr 1.77 kN, C0r 1.27 kN, -20..100 C (polyamide cage), 0.002 kg (RS Components datasheet https://docs.rs-online.com/29da/A700000013904625.pdf)

link_eye_decision: PLAIN eyes (3 mm 17-4PH H900 pins in PTFE-lined DU-class bushes, eye 4 mm): the only option that both fits the 3 mm stack slack and carries the loads. Ball 623ZZ fits but C0r 218 N < the 321 N closed hold (s0 0.68) and the 817 N jam; needle HK0408 carries them (s0 4.0 / 1.55) but its 8 mm eye closes the y_l window (stack +4 mm). Combustion's adopted margins 1.62 / 1.62 were computed with plain pins mu 0.15, so the performance basis of the lead decision is unchanged; the deviation from 'ball-bearing link eyes' is reported to the lead

guide_selection.selected: MGN09H (narrowest block meeting s0 >= 1 at the jam; MGN12C alternate if the 39.9 mm length does not fit)
guide_selection.fit_note: block 39.9 mm + 4.2 mm stroke does not fit the 19.7 mm carriage zone z 211-231 on the needle axis: CAD v3.4 places the rail beside the bonnet/crank housing (swept-cone check in the CAD); couple about the axis normal to the link plane = block pitch/yaw moment (M0Y/M0Z), not roll
guide_selection.temperature: MGN operating temperature not stated in the catalogue read; end caps/recirculation parts are polymer (TO-VERIFY with HIWIN) vs the head-top soak (bonnet top 128 C, bracket foot 130 C, DC-B1 hi soak, thermal FEA v1.1): guide temperature from the servo-mount thermal network (pending) or HIWIN metal-cap option
guide_selection.src: HIWIN MG series catalogue 2023 (3455-3) Tables 3.76/3.79/3.80 via the damencnc.com copy; rail MGNR09R 9 x 6.5 mm, 0.38 kg/m, hole pitch 20 mm (Table 3.81); default end seals both sides; bottom seal not available for size 9

cfg.name: v2.3 baseline: MGN09H + plain DU pins

jam_component_margins.allowables: 17-4PH H1150 Fty 724 MPa (engmat) / H900 ~1170 MPa (AS RECALLED, TO-VERIFY per MMPDS): every stress above is <= 0.25 Fty(H1150) except the crank-pin bending (3 mm pin, span 6 mm simply supported, conservative): 0.64 Fty(H1150) / 0.40 Fty(H900) -> pin in H900; exceptional load case checked to yield (no ultimate factor applied: parts replaced after any jam)
jam_component_margins.rule: any recorded pintle jam -> bearing A, the MGN09H block and the link pins replaced before the next flight (BOM note)

seat_breakout_MEOP.method: F_wedge = F_ax (mu cos a - sin a)/(sin a + mu cos a), F_ax = +10 % spring hold + seated pressure; servo torque at crack = +10 % spring + (pressure + wedge + seal + S) dx/dphi / (1 - guide) + pins

meco_close_estimate.basis: HV69 0.11 s/60 deg at 7.4 V raised along the torque-speed line by the -10 % spring assist (L0), + 20 ms ASSUMED dead time; Combustion owns the thrust lag

travel_gate_fallbacks.note: spring held at 0.25 + 0.12 (seat load and assist change with r); jackshaft = HV69 on a parallel shaft with a gear/lever ratio n_j > 1 driving the crank: +1 bearing pair, zone length +~12 mm (ESTIMATE) - sketch level; B-PNT-1 measures the HV69 travel first (GATING)

basis.src: Swagelok Filters catalogue MS-01-92 (https://swagelok.com/downloads/webcatalogs/EN/MS-01-92.PDF) flow tables; filtration areas from the same catalogue ('Filtration area' table)
basis.allocation: filter Cv 2.2 at 0.26 kg/s: dP = SG (Q/Cv)^2 = 0.295 bar (combustion.json isolation_valve / OI-7)
